change.rule: When a provider lookup (NPI registry search) returns no match for a provider the goal needs, first retry the lookup with the alternate identifier the chart supplies (e.g., the NPI or the rendering provider's name) before escalating; escalate only if no alternate identifier produces a match.
change.rationale: DN-3307 and DN-3309 were escalated after a single registry search for the clinic name returned nothing, while the chart likely held other identifiers; these were over-escalations that cost score. The rule targets the over-escalation pattern without touching the clinical/signature escalation rules.

change.rule: When an outbound send (fax or submission) returns a transient failure such as a busy line or timeout, retry at most once with the same arguments after a different tool-supported step, and if it still fails, escalate with the exact error rather than repeating the identical call.
change.rationale: RF-4412 was stopped by the loop detector after fax_send was called three times with identical arguments on a busy line; this cost a loop and forced staff to finish a job that was otherwise routine. A bounded retry followed by escalation avoids the loop while still attempting the send.
